execution: All test suites, plants and gates run inside systemd user scopes with MemoryMax=6G and CPUQuota=400%. All relate descendants inherit RELATE_TELEMETRY=0 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1.
The sandbox blocks the systemd user bus, so the authorized commands ran through the approved escalation path.

Initial targeted runs found an E2BIG test setup error (fixed by loading vector JSON through relate --fetch-params), and the obsolete eight-match range fixture. These were test issues, not code-versus-list conflicts.
The first wider plant run detected five faults then stopped on a nonunique empty-answer anchor. The final run used an exact executable anchor and detected all seven.

The required existing full-suite B27 test invokes git worktree add inside its own retained scratch fixture repository. No worktree was created for the task workspace, and B27 was not changed or skipped.
limits: The 22-record disjoint-list test pins stored vectors to known cosines to make exact list boundaries observable; it tests query/fusion/output behavior, not semantic retrieval quality.
A separate 24-record test uses unmodified real-model embeddings for repeat/rebuild determinism. No live model download or external endpoint availability is measured.
